title: Polish the History page and a season's history on mobile
request: /factory-polish the history page and actually looking at an individual seasons history on mobile

criteria.text: History list: the season title is no longer squeezed and its date is not clipped at 390, 360 and 320px; champion and highlight text is not cut to a few letters; the Full Season Recap strip is 44px high
criteria.evidence: History list, real browser, fake data, before at :4173 versus after (dev and production build), 390/360/320: season title width 91 to 156px at 390 (a long season 88px on 10 lines to 219px on 4), 45 to 149px at 320; the date overlapped the Completed pill in 6 cards at 320 and 1 at 360, none after; names cut with an ellipsis at 320: 22 to 2 (only the made-up 80-character names); 'Husk Busters (...' now shows its number; the Full Season Recap strip 33 to 44px at 390/360/320 and still 41px at 768 and wider (production scan: it is no longer on the small-target list on phones). I looked at the 320 before and after pair myself (files history-list-320-light-a.png, before and after folders).

criteria.text: Opening a season on a phone no longer flashes a huge list before collapsing (per-frame height sample before and after)
criteria.evidence: Per-frame height sample opening a season at 390 (flick.mjs): before 351px growing to 7,162px at about 320ms with 144 stat cells drawn, then snapping to 700px; after (dev, and my own run on the production build) 358px growing smoothly to 707px, 0 stat cells in every frame. The new no-flash test fails on the old code (the standings table was called once) and passes on the new; resizing from 800 to 390 with a season open still closes the divisions (kept effect).

criteria.text: Opened season: team names are not cut to one line, a past season with no standings shows a clear message, and the standings text colours in the light theme are 4.5:1 or better (crown 3:1)
criteria.evidence: Opened season: team names on the phone cards wrap to 2 lines instead of one cut line (17 cards at 6 width and theme combinations compared: only the long-name cards changed; the record stays on the right; I looked at the 320 pair). A past season with no rows, and a season with only hidden divisions, show 'No standings recorded for this season'; error, loading and active-season states are unchanged (before and after pictures, and 5 tests, 2 of which fail on the old code). Contrast measured on the real painted background: green 3.05 to 4.68, orange 2.73 to 4.94, crown 1.89 to 4.98 (light, phone cards); desktop rows 3.08 to 4.73, 2.89 to 5.22, 1.85 to 4.86; red-600 4.51 and blue-600 4.96 unchanged; dark red 4.04 to 5.32 and blue 4.09 to 5.82 (I measured these on the page); the reviewer recomputed the dark values independently.

criteria.text: Accessibility: the champion and runner-up icons have text for a screen reader, and the division chevron button has a label and aria-expanded
criteria.evidence: Accessible text read from the page: champion row went from 'Ke Kernel Panic 10-2...' to 'Champion Ke Kernel Panic 10-2...', runner-up from 'Husk Busters 11-1...' to 'Runner-up Husk Busters 11-1...', a rank-3 row has no extra text, desktop rows the same; the sr-only span is 1x1px and absolute so nothing moved. The division chevron button had no name and no aria-expanded; now its name is 'Toggle Competitive teams' (static) and aria-expanded goes false, true, false by click and by the Enter key; tests added.

criteria.text: Admin edit mode: Save Changes stays on screen at 390 and 360px when there is an unsaved change
criteria.evidence: Admin edit mode with a fake admin and 8 unsaved changes: at 390 Save Changes was at x 265 to 417 on a 390px screen; after, Reset x51-190 and Cancel x198-339 on line 1 and Save Changes x51-339 on line 2; 360 the same; at 640 and 768 the buttons are in the same place as before. Known and left alone: at 640 to about 669px Save Changes is still clipped by up to 30px; I tried wrapping below 768px instead and measured that it also changes 680 to 767px where the old row fit, so I kept the planned 640px switch.

criteria.text: The fixes also look right at 768 and 844px and do not change the 1280px desktop view, in light and dark
criteria.evidence: 768, 844 and 1280: opened-season card heights identical before and after (3,041, 3,041 and 1,901px) with 99.6 to 99.8 percent pixel overlap; the list at 1280 identical; the only differences are the darker light-theme colours (shared colour helper), the amber crown, and at 768 and wider a long champion name now wraps to 2 lines instead of an ellipsis. Light and dark checked for every changed colour.

criteria.text: No new console errors, no sideways scroll, existing tests pass (updated only where the changed text, classes or aria attributes are asserted, never weakened), six checks pass, independent review approves the final commit
criteria.evidence: At the final head 436768a: all six checks pass (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit; the lead ran them once at this head). Independent review APPROVE for everything after a3da97c, then a short re-check of the follow-up fixes. Tests: 40 files and 425 tests for src/components/history, the util and src/pages passed before the rank-0 test was added; the table file has 49 tests after it. No existing assertion weakened (the only edits to old tests are router wrappers, sessionStorage.clear set-up and re-anchored lookups; the reviewer compared the diff). Browser (builder, dev server, fake data, 3 themes, 2 widths, open/click/Back): no page errors, no warnings; the only console lines are the deliberate fake 500 for one season and its dev log line. Sideways scroll: 0 of 4 tables scroll at 1024/1280/1536, none at 844, 768, 390, 360, 320.

criteria.text: Docs: every document that describes a changed behaviour is updated in the same change, with no broken link and the verification totals still true
criteria.evidence: A docs builder rewrote the claims these changes made wrong in past-seasons.md, on-a-phone.md, accessibility.md and 4 verification rows (HIST-13, HIST-17, PHONE-16, A11Y-22; none added or removed; the HIST-17 suspected-bug marker stays), and updated UX-AUDIT-2026-09.md HI-02 (partly done) and HI-03 (done). I re-ran the link check (2,738 links, 0 broken) and recounted with the README method: 1,958 items and 120 P1 suspected-bug rows, as the README says; the reviewer checked the claims, that exactly 4 rows changed with identical ID sets, and that footers are still the last paragraph.

criteria.text: Phone standings cards show the playoff finish as '#N' for any team with a playoff rank (except a crown with rank 1 or a medal with rank 2, where the icon already says it), the same number the desktop Rank column shows, and nothing for an unranked team; the cards do not shift
criteria.evidence: Phone cards, builder measurement on fake data plus I looked at d-R-ranked-390-light.png: ranks 3 and 4 show '#3' and '#4' left of the logo, the champion has the crown and the runner-up the medal with no number, a champion edited to rank 4 shows crown and '#4', a rank-1 team with no champion flag shows '#1', unranked teams show nothing. Phone number equals the desktop Rank column for all 66 teams in 3 fake seasons (0 mismatches). A finish of 0 now shows nothing, like the desktop dash (new test; it fails on the old check, which I proved). Contrast of the number: light 7.5:1, dark 5.9:1, winter 6.75:1. Card heights are identical in 160 cards before and after; the only difference is a long name at rank 3 that is 24px narrower with the same line count. Screen readers hear 'Playoff rank #N'. Criterion text corrected by hand by the lead (rule is any rank, except the crown at 1 and the medal at 2; it said 'ranks 3 and up').

criteria.text: Team names are links to the team page in the opened season (phone cards, desktop rows) and the Champions card, with a keyboard focus ring and a 44px tap area on phone cards and desktop rows (about 27px on the Champions card, where rows are only 6px apart); a team with an unknown name stays plain text
criteria.evidence: Builder measurement (hit-testing at 390, 320 and 1280) plus I looked at d-L-focus-390-light.png: tap area 44px high on phone cards and desktop rows; the Champions card is about 27px high (27 at 390 and 1280, 27 or 41 at 320 for two-line names) because its rows are 6px apart and two 44px areas would overlap. The 4 champion hit boxes in a season never overlap (gaps 9 to 40px). Tab order: Recap strip, division chevron, team links in rank order, next chevron. The focus ring is visible. Enter on a link opened /teams/pit-crew. Accessible names equal the team names, no nested interactive elements. The 2 'Unknown Team' cards are plain text (0 links to /teams/unknown-team). Closed season card, Champions and Highlights heights are identical before and after in 40 comparisons. Criterion text corrected by hand by the lead (it said 44px for the Champions card too: it is about 27px). 27px passes the 24px WCAG 2.2 minimum target size (my reading; the reviewer did not check the spec text).

criteria.text: Back from a team page returns to the same view: the seasons and divisions the player had open stay open (real browser, phone width), and a reload in the same tab keeps them; the scroll position is restored on a best-effort basis only (an existing shared hook races; NOT fixed here)
criteria.evidence: Back from a team page at 390px, builder 10 runs with the page data cached: season and division open 10 of 10; scroll position back exactly in 3 of 10 (907 to 907), otherwise 25px from the top (-882). 10 runs after a reload of the team page: open 10 of 10; exact in 2 of 10, otherwise 309px (7 runs) or 25px. My own 5 runs on the dev server: open 5 of 5; exact in 4 of 5. So the OPEN STATE is reliable and the SCROLL POSITION IS NOT. Cause is an existing race in src/hooks/useScrollRestoration.ts (shared by /teams, /stats, /history, /insights): it saves a clamped position as the shorter team page replaces the page; on a cache miss it restores while the page is still short. A 4-line experiment (skip the save when the URL already changed) made the cached case 10 of 10 exact; it is saved but NOT applied (shared hook, out of scope, needs the owner's decision). Also measured: a top-bar History link after leaving opens fully collapsed (memory cleared); a reload of /history keeps season #2 and its first division open at the same scroll; shrinking 800 to 390 with a season open closes all 4 divisions and keeps the season open. Criterion text narrowed by hand by the lead from 'the scroll position comes back' to 'best-effort', and disclosed to the owner.

criteria.text: At 1024 and 1280px an opened season shows one column so Power and SOS are not hidden behind sideways scroll and names are not cut; phone and tablet layouts unchanged
criteria.evidence: Before at :4173 versus after (dev server), 1536, 1280 and 1024px: before 3 columns, tables 421, 368 and 283px wide against 559px needed, 4 of 4 tables scrolled sideways, Power and SOS cut off, 34 team names shortened; after 1 column, 0 of 4 tables scroll sideways, Power and SOS visible, 0 names shortened, no page overflow. 844, 768, 390, 360 and 320px: season card and division panel heights identical to before. I looked at d-G-1280-light.png before and after myself: the 368px table with cut-off names became one full table.

criteria.text: Docs: every document that describes team names as plain text, the missing phone rank, the three-column layout, or the page forgetting what was open is updated in the same change
criteria.evidence: A docs builder rewrote past-seasons.md (simple case, strip, leaving the page, beginning, URL state, viewport row, keys row, back and reload rows, on a phone, accessibility, rank bullet, open question, 'not confirmed by hand', footer), verification rows HIST-03/04/05/12/13/14/17/24/27/38, PHONE-16, A11Y-22, NAV-02, navigation.md, on-a-phone.md, accessibility.md, the glossary and a UX-AUDIT HI-02 note. I read the full diff and corrected two errors (it said Tab order and Unknown Team were only read from code; they were checked in a browser; and 'Playoff rank N' should be '#N'). The reviewer then asked for two more wording fixes (label the 66-team figure as a measurement; a typed or bookmarked address counts as a reload) which I made. I re-ran the link check (2,742 links, 0 broken) and recounted: 1,958 items and 120 P1 suspected-bug rows, as the README says; no row added or removed; every touched footer is still the last paragraph; scroll restore is written as best effort with the measured numbers.

reviews.summary: Independent plan review: all causes real, line numbers right, flash reproduced in the current build (7,162px at ~320ms then 700px). Four blocking objections accepted and written into the plan: (1) the empty-season condition would show falsely when offline or for hidden-only seasons: use !season.is_active && seasonData && Object.keys(divisionData).length === 0 after the active branch; (2) the flash fix needs a test that can fail (mock the standings table and assert it is never called on mobile); (3) the admin toolbar needs flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap; (4) the chevron label must be static (Toggle X teams) with aria-expanded. Also adopted: md:min-h-0 on the recap strip, crown colour matching the Champions crown, measure all colour arms, desktop crown sr-only, test file ownership, named docs.

Independent review at e9649ca of the History phone polish (9 code commits, docs). All changed History files are imported only by the History page (importers checked); nothing changed in src/components/ui or shared files; tailwind-merge keeps every changed class string and the classes are valid in this repo; no hydration problem (no SSR in the app); the no-flash test fails on the old DivisionPanel (the standings table was called once) and the two chevron tests fail there too; the empty-season message cannot show while loading, offline, on error, for an active season or in edit mode (checked in the component); the Lead's dark-colour edit recomputed independently (blue-400 5.82, red-400 5.35, before 4.03 and 3.93); 35 test files and 346 tests pass; 10 doc claims checked; exactly 4 verification rows changed with identical ID sets; totals unchanged (1,958 and 120); footers still last. Both deviations from the plan (empty-season message inside the normal view so the admin Edit Divisions button stays; line-clamp-3 on the record and division line) accepted. Non-blocking notes: Save Changes still clipped at 640 to about 669px in admin edit mode (disclosed); the tests pin only the light colour arms, not the new dark ones; the windowed list above 30 teams uses a fixed row height of 140 that was already too small; one doc sentence says 'Those notes' without naming them.

Independent plan review of the three owner decisions plus the Lead's remember-what-is-open addition: five blocking objections, all accepted and written into the plan: (1) restore the open state only on a POP navigation and clear it otherwise, so a click on History still opens a fully collapsed page as documented; (2) add initial={false} to both AnimatePresence tags so restored content is full height and the scroll restore does not land short; report cache-hit and cache-miss results; (3) list the existing test repairs (sessionStorage.clear, required seasonId, MemoryRouter, re-anchor vacuous assertions); (4) nest the link so hit-area-44 works, no min-h-11, 24px on the Champions card; (5) the rank rule is: show #N unless it is the champion's 1 or the runner-up's 2, because admin edits can leave a champion with rank 4. Also: react-router Link without state, hover:underline, plain text for Unknown Team, one column and not xl:grid-cols-2, new DivisionPanel effect given.

Independent CODE review of everything after a3da97c (one column, team links + phone rank, remembered open state, comment fix, docs), then a short re-check of the follow-up fixes (rank 0, two doc sentences). APPROVE, no blocking findings. Reviewer read the full diff and ran 40 History/pages files, 425 tests, all pass (49 in the table file after the fix). Verified in code: storage access guarded and booleans only; the clear runs once on mount before children read memory (StrictMode safe); a top-bar click on /history is a REPLACE with no remount; the division effect closes only on the desktop-to-phone transition; no key collisions; links use the same slug helper as the rest of the app; Unknown Team matches the service; no link nested in a button or link; admin edit board untouched; no existing assertion weakened. Non-blocking findings: (1) Champions tap area is about 27px, criterion said 44px (disclosed in code, docs; criterion text corrected by the lead); (2) rank 0 phone vs desktop mismatch: FIXED with a test that fails on the old code; (3) 66-team figure lacked a measurement label: FIXED; (4) a typed or bookmarked address counts as a reload: FIXED in docs; (5) a division left open stays open when its season is closed and reopened: follows the stated rule, left alone; (6) side effect in a lazy useState initializer is idempotent: left alone. Could NOT verify (browser only): rendered sizes, the 140px virtualised row height with a wrapped name next to #N, AnimatePresence initial={false} on a click-open, the e2e a11y spec.

interventions.why: Owner answered the three product decisions with 'go with your recommendations': show a #N playoff rank on the phone standings cards, make team names links to the team page, drop the three-column layout at 1024 and 1280px. Folded into this task, which was READY but not yet closed.
